about: Every message Aaron typed or dictated in this session on Terra (the PC), copied verbatim from its log on 25 September 2026. Only his words. Taken from both places the log keeps them - the queued record of every message he sends and the plain user records - each message kept once at its earliest time. Messages he sent while Claude was still working sit in time order with the rest and are not marked apart, because a queued record alone does not show that. System text, tool output, skill instructions, task notifications, cross-session messages, compaction summaries and anything the studio wrote are excluded, as are the helper agents' logs beside this one.
title: Game menu screen and development plan

messages.text: There is one change that needs to be made to the UI - there is no where that says new game. We need to implement a menu screen that is easily seen and when clicked it should create a pop up that shows the options of save game, load game, new game, and any other options that could be move to that. Once you are done with that I want you to go through https://claude.ai/code/artifact/c59687c5-33fb-45f6-9bff-304eae5060c7?org=c0e4d5ef-d59d-4158-a030-03de3f347626 and put together a plan for executing the next stepd of development as laid out in that doc.

nation-states will continue to be the working title for internal development and we will await for the brand specialist to get back to us with the final name. Skip the renaming and move forward with implementing everything.
Commence with building everything all the way through m13

Ok this is really great. One thing is I want to start playtesting it and send it to other people. The problem is that those people are in other locations. 

What is the best way to ship this to them for them to play test. 

Is it something that could be played in a browser and still retain all functions (save load etc?) or is this something that would need to be shipped as a folder/program? 

One other thing that would be good to include (and I would let the players know this) is something that would create a log of what the players did as a way to measure after the fact thigns.
For hosting it can I host it with my Claude subscription. Else - I have a squarespace website I pay for can I host it there?
